/**
 * Utility functions for formatting data
 *//**
 * Format price in Algerian Dinar
 * @param {number} price - Price in centimes
 * @returns {string} Formatted price string
 */export const formatPrice=price=>{if(typeof price!=='number'||isNaN(price)){return'0 DA';}return"".concat(price.toLocaleString('fr-DZ')," DA");};/**
 * Format date to French locale
 * @param {string|Date} date - Date to format
 * @returns {string} Formatted date string
 */export const formatDate=date=>{const dateObj=typeof date==='string'?new Date(date):date;if(!(dateObj instanceof Date)||isNaN(dateObj)){return'';}return dateObj.toLocaleDateString('fr-FR',{year:'numeric',month:'long',day:'numeric'});};/**
 * Format phone number for display
 * @param {string} phone - Phone number to format
 * @returns {string} Formatted phone number
 */export const formatPhone=phone=>{if(!phone){return'';}const cleaned=phone.replace(/\D/g,'');const match=cleaned.match(/^(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})$/);if(match){return"".concat(match[1]," ").concat(match[2]," ").concat(match[3]," ").concat(match[4]);}return phone;};/**
 * Generate array of specified length
 * @param {number} length - Array length
 * @returns {Array} Array of undefined values
 */export const generateArray=length=>{return Array.from({length});};/**
 * Truncate text to specified length
 * @param {string} text - Text to truncate
 * @param {number} maxLength - Maximum length
 * @returns {string} Truncated text
 */export const truncateText=function(text){let maxLength=arguments.length>1&&arguments[1]!==undefined?arguments[1]:100;if(text.length<=maxLength){return text;}return"".concat(text.substring(0,maxLength),"...");};
